tokens.name: attention.color
tokens.role: Use stronger color to direct attention and state, with sufficient contrast and a clear hierarchy.

tokens.name: icon.language.rounded
tokens.role: Use a coherent thicker, rounded icon language when the product calls for a more approachable creative tone.
tokens.notes: Do not mix with unrelated thin-outline icon systems.

tokens.name: depth.hierarchy
tokens.role: Use depth to separate layers and focus attention rather than as decoration on every container.
tokens.notes: Surface depth should map to hierarchy.

tokens.name: expression.accessibility
tokens.role: Increase visual expression only when contrast, state clarity, and platform usability remain intact.
tokens.notes: Original synthesis of the source guidance.
